Persons who are employed by any of the Source Agencies are not permitted to trade on the Contract.

important_info.markdown: **Important information:** If the fight ends in a draw/no contest, both markets will resolve to **$0.50**. If the fight is cancelled or postponed more than 48 hours from its originally scheduled start, both markets will resolve to a **fair price**. Note that any revisions after Expiration will not be considered. Therefore, if a fighter is disqualified, removed, or the official result of the fight is reversed or changed in any way after the Contract expires, that will not impact resolution.
